summary: An answer-component shortcut solves all five delivered questions and all 10 reproduced generated inventory items. Sampling also excludes legitimate source-backed cases, and three current source profiles are unsupported. Package unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Use Gauss-Jordan elimination to identify basic and free variables and select the complete one-parameter vector solution.
reasoning_steps: Express basic variables in the free variable and select the full solution set.
invariants: Small consistent real linear systems with one free variable.
Elementary row operations and comparable easy-level workload.
Five-choice radio response with exactly one complete solution set.
permitted_variations: Coefficients, constants, signs and zero terms.
Pivot/free-variable assignments supported by the source.

source_replay.details: Eleven supported profiles reproduce their complete mathematical banks. Three current easy profiles reject as unknown; the canonical alternate free-variable family is unavailable.

math.details: All 81 tested easy records passed independent exact checks of printed systems, complete solution sets, keys, displayed row operations and final solution vectors.

variety.details: Default sampling fixes one authored family and excludes source-backed rank-one, zero-slope, zero-constant and alternate free-variable cases. Valid zero-slope and equal-coordinate inputs reject.

scope.details: Tested easy outputs preserve the source method, response format and elementary workload. This does not certify moderate/hard difficulty.

grading.details: The native grader produced 96 expected acceptances and 384 expected rejections, with none unresolved. Relevant changes reject the previous answer; equivalent row mixing preserves acceptance.

rendering.details: Actual UI rendered 21 representative records and all five delivered records. Representative screenshots, including controlled pairs, fractions and subscripts, were inspected.

packaging.details: Exact dependency versions match. Deterministic replay and relocation passed. Package files remained unchanged; no publication or database writes occurred.

decision_variation.details: Matching modal first and second answer components selects 5/5 delivered keys, 59/59 eligible fresh keys, and 10/10 reproduced inventory keys without examining the equations. One of 60 fresh samples caused an abstention.

findings.description: The fixed distractor recipe reveals the correct vector through repeated components. For x+y-z=5 and x+2y-4z=9, the correct first component occurs twice and the correct second component three times; their unique intersection identifies the key.
findings.reproduction: Run `/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python -B reproduce_failure.py shortcut` from evidence_root. Seed 90217; parameters {"free_coefficients":[2,-3],"constants":[1,4],"mix":[1,1]}. The strict regression fails. See minimal-shortcut.json.
findings.requested_change: Change the family-wide bank construction so component repetition does not determine correctness. Regenerate the five-question batch and address the 10 demonstrated stored instances listed in affected-inventory.json.

findings.description: Normal sampling excludes legitimate mathematical cases to preserve fixed distractor recipes. A constant basic coordinate and equal basic-coordinate expressions both cause valid systems to reject.
findings.reproduction: Run `reproduce_failure.py zero-slope` and `reproduce_failure.py equal-coordinates` with the context Python and -B. The first rejects parameters free_coefficients=[0,-3], constants=[1,4], mix=[1,1], although they give the valid solution x=1, y=4+3z. Exact failures are retained in strict-regressions.json.
findings.requested_change: Include justified observed families and eligible role assignments in ordinary easy sampling. Adapt distractors to cancellation and equal-coordinate cases instead of excluding valid systems because an error recipe collides.

findings.description: Current source profiles q-131714, q-131713 and q-42062 are unsupported. The canonical three-variable free-y/pivot-z construction is also absent.
findings.reproduction: Run `/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python -B reproduce_failure.py source`. Profile q-131714 with scale=1 and offsets=[0,0,0] raises unknown profile. source-replay.json records the other missing profiles.
findings.requested_change: Implement and replay the supplied current source prompts, complete banks and solution patterns. Preserve q-42062’s finite-point distractor as an incorrect incomplete solution, and support the canonical alternate pivot/free-variable family.
